targets.note: Any three of the four, whichever lands (Keyson advises against chasing one element, TWgmQuiLeHA 2:01–3:15). Creators aim T1 on the first two and settle for T2/T3 on the last; the owner's 2026-10-05 market sample mixes elements freely, physical in 4 of 5.

Suffix set 'any of {resistances, rarity, attack speed}'. Market listings carry these not necessarily at T1; creators aim T1 res. Attack speed is not in the natural ring pool (craft catalog 0.5.5b) but appears on listed rings; how it gets there (essence or alloy) is unresolved, so its source is null.

patchFloor.note: Date from the patch-notes index (official_patch row 3932556 'Content-Update 0.5.0 – Path of Exile 2: Return of the Ancients', published May 22, 2026, 3:00:51 AM; that index snapshot came from a non-English forum mirror). The url is the English 0.5.0 notes thread the KB cites. Servers launched 2026-05-29 (docs/kb/atlas-juicing.md patch stamp), so uploads between the two dates are pre-launch previews.
